authorization: user requested parallel next experiment plan and normal GitHub publication; launch prompt supplied for execution host

inheritance.parent: MM02 round6 supervised full training checkpoint; exact location from original manifest
inheritance.seed_scope: independent fine-tuning RNG from shared inherited initialization, not from-scratch seeds

rescue.causal_claim: intervention rescue, not complete factorial decomposition

low_level.factorization: 3 train scenes x 8 command profiles x 4 legal arm profiles
low_level.command_units: m/s and rad/s effective requests after navigation stop/deadband/hysteresis; phase limits represented upstream; not raw requested_rate or amplified last_turn
low_level.learned_integral_memory: causal recurrent state or documented explicit estimate, never teacher integrator as deployment input
low_level.local_teacher_adapter: new query-only command-conditioned, uniformly limited 2ms feedback/integral/leg control sampled at20ms; independent version, no world-target proxy or hidden mode
low_level.bias_labels: BaseDrive.leg_commands includes bias: remove once; P6CorrectionTeacher raw/target already pre-bias: do not remove again
low_level.adapter_case_dedup: may coincide with the exact same physical episode in 96 complete demos, count once
low_level.contact_data: B complete demos and legal continuation sequences at grasp/open/hold/release feed A existing correction budgets

B.teacher_factorization: 3 train scenes x 4 tasks x 8 registered training perturbation seeds
B.sampling: phase groups then side/goal/scene/episode; log empty strata and fallbacks
B.h9_wm_initialization: clone matched H9 full package including optimizer before pairing

d23_additional_budget_sensitivity.parent: selected D23 full checkpoint for each seed
d23_additional_budget_sensitivity.data: common eligible data only; no fabricated task/command labels
d23_additional_budget_sensitivity.evaluation: 20 disclosed regression cases per seed before any new blind, total60, outside324 main denominator
d23_additional_budget_sensitivity.scope: budget sensitivity, not proof of identical training information

B.extend_after_initial_block: automatic 4-round block if matched development full success improves or next ordered event improves in >=2 side/goal tasks without losing already achieved full successes
B.plateau_close: only after all key A/B/C implementations executed and two consecutive 4-round blocks without registered physical progress or concrete validated repair
B.recurrent_prefix: shadow update with real observations/actions from frame0; preserve hidden at same weights, reconstruct by real-prefix burn-in after weight changes; never initialize with teacher state or silently zero
B.new_command_label_semantics: same executed adapter version; legacy missing command labels not fabricated

C.initial_parent: MM02 R6 supervised full training state
C.gradient_budget_formula: min(0.15, 0.25*norm(g_BC)/(norm(g_traj)+epsilon)), detached, same trainable parameter set
C.real_transition: current student actual action, native 10 x 2ms substeps
C.backward: frozen learned WM Jacobian plus causal bridge surrogate at actual camera exposure; not native physics derivative
C.loss: same differentiable teacher trajectory loss plus BC, Torch recomputation on replaced tensors
C.native_directional_response: small signed perturbations of parameters/actions from fixed physical snapshots, report actual objective response, not only model-internal FD
C.selected_model_variant: best numerically legal non-BC candidate by fixed development selection before blind; confirm matched H9 pairing
C.if_all_model_variants_invalid: H9-WM not executed with reason; D23/H9 continue
C.bridge_binding: MM02 supervised R6 encoder; common train exposures only; all variants/seeds share binding; keep encoder_id verification
C.gradient_budget_objective: Ltraj excludes 0.15; gtraj = grad(Ltraj), Ltotal = Lbc + detached(lambda_eff)*Ltraj; avoid weighting twice

real_state_projection.robot_aux: same GenCoord layout and zero-translation/zero-linear-velocity gauge as old model; anchor yaw removal; sensor(adapter) equals real proprio
real_state_projection.contact: 20ms finger thresholds and bilateral fraction; logit(clamp(c,1e-4,1-1e-4))
real_state_projection.initial_state: same model.initial for every model branch; real projection replacement starts at first successor
real_state_projection.previous_action_and_prefix: actual23; preserve nine pre-anchor observations, exact clock and exposure phase; new recurrent modules additionally burn in
real_state_projection.student_execution: new on-policy branch runner; do not reuse old anchor runner that unconditionally executes teacher
real_state_projection.camera_age: hold last true image/features between exposures; update t-image_t every20ms and reset at actual exposure

termination.normalization: fixed planned H discounted denominator for every model variant
termination.step_loss_cap: Cmax = max(1, 2*P99.9 of per-step weighted trajectory loss on fixed training-anchor calibration before first optimization), freeze and record value/membership
termination.valid_loss: min(step_loss,Cmax), record cap rate; same fresh-vision weighting definition
termination.unexecuted_tail: absorbing Cmax penalty only, not fake real states; terminal mask/cost detached
termination.partial_control_interval: store actual partial_dt and terminal observation; not a full20ms training successor
termination.zero_valid_batch: BC only, model gradient0, no claimed H32 update
termination.causal_limit: early failure changes effective gradient horizon; report mask/termination rate, do not attribute all gain solely to forward drift
termination.calibration_anchors: fixed sorted eligible training anchors, at most256 unique, common parent C32 imagination before any optimization; record exact membership; no validation/test

C.frozen_low_level_derivatives: only freeze L16 parameters; retain all input/history/recurrent/command derivatives, no no_grad/inference_mode/detach across low-level

evaluation.absent_method_not_counted_as_run: report unexecuted count and reason, retain planned denominator separately

execution.publish: normal fast-forward GitHub commits with exact code/results/weights/video paths; no force push
